basic_info.description:
A private entrance to this dramatic light-filled loft-style townhome featuring one bedroom on the upper level with a half bathroom and a den with a full bath on the main living level. A thoughtfully designed kitchen with granite counters, custom maple cabinetry and inviting living room with 17 foot floor to ceiling windows that enjoy a warm southern exposure. There is direct access to a private deeded terrace creating a perfect flow for indoor/outdoor entertaining. The maple flooring and in-unit laundry add to the units appeal. There is parking with interior access for one car and a designated storage area in the garage. A community garden across the street and just blocks to UCSF Mt. Zion, NOPA, Japan Town and Alamo Square Park, make this central location ideal for city dwellers in search of value.

Please visit www.basilica101.com for more info.
